description: Header file providing AIDL (Android Interface Definition Language) support for AHardwareBuffer, including functions for parcel serialization/deserialization and a wrapper class for managing AHardwareBuffer pointers.

classes.name: HardwareBuffer
classes.description: Wrapper class that manages AHardwareBuffer* ownership and provides parcel read/write methods.

methods.name: readFromParcel
methods.description: Reads an AHardwareBuffer from a parcel, acquiring an initial reference.

methods.name: writeToParcel
methods.description: Writes an AHardwareBuffer to a parcel.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Releases current buffer and takes ownership of a new AHardwareBuffer*.

methods.name: operator->
methods.description: Provides access to the underlying AHardwareBuffer*.

methods.name: operator bool
methods.description: Checks if the wrapper currently owns a buffer.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases ownership of the buffer and returns the AHardwareBuffer*.
